title: Warped Headband of Intellect
summary: Sets Intelligence to at least 17 while equipped.

fields.Intelligence: If your Intelligence is below 17, it becomes 17. A naturally higher score stays intact. The source reports that Wizards keep spells they prepared using the higher score even after removing the headband.
fields.Acquisition: Loot Lump the Enlightened in Act One, including if you summon him after first hiring his ogres.
fields.Base value: 250 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
